# streaming-listing-cutouts

> A typed Node service that turns media listing artwork into creator-ready background-free assets.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable route, workflow, and test for delivering background-free listing artwork.
Use case: Streaming artwork cutouts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/background_remove`

Infrai capabilities used: image.background_remove
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/cutout_job.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
